text:
marco: Quick question — we have a config change: routing.prefer_low_cost (will bias routing toward cheaper variants). Because it interacts with sticky sessions we should have a preflight + runbook before flipping. My proposed flow: 1) static lint, 2) dry-run (shadow) 1% traffic for 30m, 3) telemetry assertions (error delta <0.2%, latency P95 delta <15ms, quota drift <1%), 4) owner sign-off in console, 5) auto rollback on failing assertions. Thoughts?

alia: Agree on preflight. Two risky bits: sticky session affinity and quota accounting. If a session changes model mid-session we can double-charge tokens or leak reservation tokens. Need session-tagging and an eviction policy for in-flight sessions (prefer keep-old-model). :eyes:

dinesh: We should expose a dry-run flag in the internal config API so infra can route shadow copies without changing state. e.g.:

```json
POST /config/apply
{
  "key":"routing.prefer_low_cost",
  "value":true,
  "preflight":{
    "mode":"shadow",
    "sample_rate":0.01,
    "duration_secs":1800
  }
}
```

carla: +1. Draft preflight envelope I sketched for the console:

```json
{
  "preflight_id":"pf-20260320-01",
  "checks":["lint","schema","shadow_traffic","telemetry_assertions"],
  "telemetry_assertions":{
    "error_rate_delta_pct":0.2,
    "p95_latency_ms":15,
    "quota_drift_pct":1
  },
  "stakeholders":["owner","ops"],
  "auto_rollback":true
}
```

ben: How do we compute baselines for the assertions? Traffic shape can change massively during a 30m window. We should compare to a rolling baseline (+/- 24h same-window) or use control cohorts. Also if shadow traffic hits different hosts we need consistent sampling.

sai: I can add a preflight tile in the console that links to the snapshot and assertion results. For baselines I prefer a rolling-mean with anomaly-tolerant bounds (robust z-score). We'll also persist full metric snapshots (time series) to S3 with the preflight_id so audits + replays work.

ops-bot: preflight started: pf-20260320-01 (shadow 1% for 30m) — monitoring hooks connected, alerts will fire on assertion breach.

marco: Nice, thanks. Couple follow-ups: (a) carla can you PR the preflight schema and add the owner sign-off step in console UX? (b) dinesh please add the dry-run flag to the internal API and ensure no stateful side-effects. (c) @sai please wire the tile + alert, expose link to S3 snapshot. Target: small PRs this week, toggle gated behind config-owners only. :thumbsup:

carla: I'll open the PR today and include migration notes for console text. tagging @sai and @dinesh for review.

sai: I’ll sketch the dashboard tile tonight and send a mock. I’ll also add a small alert playbook for on-call (what to look at, how to rollback pf run).

dinesh: I'll add the dry-run flag and a unit test for no-op behavior (ensure no token reservations). ETA EOD.

marco: Perfect. Let's pair for 30m tomorrow to sanity-check the assertion thresholds and failure messages. Thanks everyone. :shipit:
